I won't publish anything yet. To proceed I need an explicit confirmation that names the exact target, the exact content, and any notifications. Below I state exactly what I would change, what could go wrong, whether it can be undone, then ask you to confirm verbatim.

What I will change (example/template — I will do exactly this once you confirm):
- Action: Create a public postmortem entry and publish it.
- Target page / record: [status page URL and path you want, e.g. https://status.example.com/incidents/2026-09-03-postmortem] — you must provide the exact URL/path.
- Title: [exact title you want published]
- Content: the approved incident writeup (you must paste the final approved text here or provide a link to the final document to copy verbatim).
- Visibility: public (visible on the public status page).
- Notify: (choose) send subscriber notifications / post to Slack/Twitter or not.
- Publish time: (choose) publish immediately or schedule at YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (timezone).

What could go wrong
- Sensitive or internal-only information could be published if the writeup hasn't been fully redacted.
- Wrong/old version could be published if the content provided is not the final approved text.
- Formatting or link breakage on the status page.
- Duplicate or conflicting URL if a post already exists at the chosen path.
- Subscribers or external caches may receive/retain the announcement even if we later unpublish.

Can it be undone?
- Yes: I can unpublish or delete the post and restore previous content on the status page. However, any notifications already sent, external caches, or copies made while it was public cannot be fully retracted.

Confirmation I need from you (please copy-paste and reply exactly as shown, filling the brackets):
"Confirm publish: Publish the post titled '[TITLE]' at '[FULL STATUS PAGE URL/PATH]'. Use this exact content: '[PASTE THE FULL APPROVED WRITEUP OR PROVIDE DOC LINK]'. Publish time: [now OR YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM TZ]. Notify subscribers: [yes/no]. Crosspost to Slack/Twitter: [yes/no]."

I will perform the publish only after you reply with that exact confirmation.
